newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes sharply higher led by Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes sharply higher led by Telecom.

text.p: 1500 GMT - The Czech PX50 gains strongly at Thursday's close.
* PX50 index rises 6.4 points, 1.23 percent, to 528.5
* SPT Telecom, Komercni Banka post strong gains
* On bourse as a whole, 270 shares rise, 263 fall, 134 unchanged. Turnover 1.7 billion, volume, 1,940,521 shares
The Czech PX50 pushed further ahead on Thursday with the most heavily capitalised share on the bourse, SPT Telecom, again taking the lead.
The PX50 index rose 1.2 percent to 528.5 while the RPIX gained 1.7 percent to 1,102.5.
SPT Telecom rose 97 crowns to 3,279 defying dealers' expectations that the issue would fall back a little after rising 72 crowns in the previous session.
Dealers said foreign buying had again helped SPT higher on Thursday.
Komercni Banka, the biggest banking issue also built on Wednesday's rise, gaining 70 crowns to 2,200. Ceska Sporitelna was up four crowns to 320 and CEZ was unchanged on 985.
In the broader market, glass fibre maker Vertex bounced back 159 crowns to 3,352 while computer systems company PVT jumped 150 crowns to 4,000.
